text.p: Compagnie General de Geophysique said Thursday it had consolidated net sales of 953 million French francs for the first quarter of 1997, up from 605 million francs for the first quarter of 1996.

But the company said that despite higher than expected consolidated net sales for the first quarter of 1997, net income for the first half of 1997 will remain in line with original management expectations because of operating difficulties encountered in certain land operations and a temporary reduction in streamer capacity for one of its vessels in the second quarter of 1997.

The increase in sales was due to a high level of activity at Sercel, in land seismic acquisition and in data processing, which was partly offset by a lower level of marine seismic activity, the company said.
